_documentation: Defaults for scripts/data_evaluation/compare_model_predictions.py. Paths relative to sequence_to_svm_minimal/. For GNN, node layout is taken from <stem>_gnn_meta.json next to each .pt (written by run_gnn_train_final_models) or inferred from weight shapes; node_feature_groups here is only a hint—mismatches log a note and the checkpoint wins. Override toggles with --node-groups if you need to match a legacy run without meta.
